units: 430x480 art pixels; occlusion_v2.png: 255 = covered by the frame

stars.between_stars_free: gaps between neighbouring stars stay visible

bottom_note: The plaque is below the window and does not cover the art (user, 2026-11-09). A translucent 8-px shadow line (1.7 % of the height) lies over the bottom of the art; it is not counted as covered.
side_note: The art fills the window width (409.4 of 413 screen px); only the top corners are rounded, the bottom corners meet the plaque square.
method:
- window = the connected light region of the empty frame around its centre (x 56-468, y 83-539,
  413 x 457 px, aspect 0.904 vs 0.896 of the art): the art is scaled to the window height
  (0.952 screen px per art px) and centred (1.8 px spare on each side);
- occlusion = pixels of the window rectangle that are not visible: the star bottoms and the
  rounded top corners. The 8-px grey line just above the plaque (y 532-539) is a translucent
  shadow over the art, not an occlusion, and is left out;
- 2 stars: the middle star of the 3-star frame, placed at the 2-star centres measured on the
  card screenshot (spacing 0.2715 of the window width, symmetric about the centre); the mask is
  the union of the 2- and 3-star layouts, dilated by 2 art px for registration error.
